description: Scope-calibrated autonomy ladder (levels A, B, C) governed by eight external, non-self-reported trust indicators and automatic demotion circuit breakers (D-353). Quality, reliability, audit, canary, escape, flake, PR-split and security criteria enforce 100% pass / 0 failure targets (D-337); indicator 6 work-mix shares are reported diagnostically without numeric thresholds until a measured baseline exists.

main_integrity.name: Main branch integrity
main_integrity.external_source: GitHub Actions full-suite check runs on main merges (config/validation/verdicts.json)
main_integrity.note: D-337: 100% green full-suite runs on main and 0 merges accepted while main is red.

change_failure_rework.name: Change failure and rework rate
change_failure_rework.dimension: External post-merge failure rate (CFR) and 5-PR line rework
change_failure_rework.external_source: Git Revert commits, config/model/errata.json, full-suite green-to-red transitions, non-success deploy-live runs, Fixes-PR trailers, and git 5-PR line rework diff
change_failure_rework.note: D-337: 0% external post-merge escapes; 5-PR line rework rate is reported diagnostically without inventing an arbitrary tolerance.

first_pass_yield.name: First-pass yield and flake rate
first_pass_yield.dimension: PR check pass rate on first attempt plus VERIFY-ALONE flake visibility
first_pass_yield.external_source: GitHub tower/gate PR check runs (config/validation/slo.json) and external flake log (config/validation/runs/flakes.json)
first_pass_yield.note: D-337: 100% first-pass yield and 0% flake rate; stays unmeasured (never green) while flake telemetry is unwired.

independent_audit.name: Independent audit agreement
independent_audit.dimension: Clean approval by an independent reviewer without author history or write access
independent_audit.external_source: Independent audit records in config/governance/audits/ and retro samples declaring a distinct external reviewer
independent_audit.note: D-337: 100% clean independent approval, 0 critical/high findings, 0 metric-gaming or self-exemption cases; self-reviewed samples are excluded.

human_override_rate.name: Owner corrective intervention rate
human_override_rate.dimension: Corrective overrides, vetoes, reverts or lock violations recorded outside gitignored local paths
human_override_rate.external_source: Tracked external override log (config/governance/overrides.json); legacy gitignored docs/operations/incidents/ is detected and refused as blind
human_override_rate.note: D-337: 0 corrective owner overrides and 0 lock violations; reports unmeasured when no tracked/external source exists.

signal_to_overhead.name: Value-to-overhead work composition
signal_to_overhead.dimension: Product and real bottleneck delivery share vs. metamodel/governance maintenance and PR splitting (C8)
signal_to_overhead.external_source: Git first-parent merge diff classification on main plus consecutive same-scope PR split detection
signal_to_overhead.note: C8 (D-353): 0 sequential same-scope splits (D-337). Fixed work-mix percentages (value_share >= 0.70, meta_governance_share <= 0.15) were rejected; work-mix shares are reported diagnostically without numeric thresholds until a measured baseline exists, and adopting any future threshold requires a new decision.

production_health_and_cost.name: Production deploy health, canary and gross AWS cost
production_health_and_cost.dimension: End-to-end deploy latency (p100 + diagnostic p50/p95/p99), synthetic canary, and gross AWS spend excluding credits
production_health_and_cost.note: D-337: p100 acceptance <=1s (REQ-deploy-1s) with p50/p95/p99 and swap/reload breakdown reported diagnostically; canary 100% green; gross AWS spend verified with credits excluded (D-303).

security_posture.name: Security posture without self-exemption
security_posture.dimension: Zero open critical/high vulnerabilities, closed THREAT findings, zero session-authorized TAIL exemptions, clean Dockerfiles and multi-ecosystem audit
security_posture.external_source: config/supply/advisories.json, config/security/{vulns,threats}, config/standard/tailoring, docs/domain/decisions, tracked Dockerfiles
security_posture.note: D-337 and D-360: 0 open critical/high advisories, 0 open vulns/threat findings, 0 session-authorized, self-approved, or proposed TAIL exemptions (active TAIL exemptions require independent approval), 0 unpinned or curl|sh Dockerfiles.

levels.name: Low-risk autonomous execution
levels.scope: Documentation, tests, and internal refactors that do not alter contracts, gate tooling, security posture, or production infrastructure

levels.name: Product and delivery flow autonomy
levels.feng_role: Level 4 Approver -> Level 5 Observer (product and flow under owner-validated goals)
levels.scope: Product delivery in apps/web and gate/deploy flow optimization inside owner-validated objectives, with live canary and automatic rollback

levels.name: Autonomous backlog and unit generation
levels.feng_role: Level 5 Observer (tactical decomposition below owner-validated program objectives)
levels.scope: Autonomous generation and dispatch of backlog units below owner-validated program objectives after sustained Level B performance

circuit_breakers.reason: A broken main branch (full-suite failure or merges while red) immediately revokes autonomous execution until main is green again.
A post-merge escape, revert, or deploy failure immediately revokes autonomous execution until root cause is fixed.
Any open critical/high vulnerability, open threat finding, Dockerfile supply-chain defect, or unapproved TAIL exemption immediately revokes autonomous execution.

always_owner_locked.domain: Intention, primary metrics, objectives and limits (docs/SEMENTE.md, config/intent/INT-*.json)
always_owner_locked.reason: SEMENTE section 6 intention lock and D-353: only Daniel validates changes to intention, objectives and limits.

always_owner_locked.domain: Money, spending, purchases, billing and budget above approved ceiling
always_owner_locked.reason: D-260, D-360 and D-353: money and spend above ceiling stay locked to Daniel.

always_owner_locked.domain: Other people (messages, commitments or actions toward third parties)
always_owner_locked.reason: D-260, D-360 and D-353: actions involving other people stay locked to Daniel.

independent_approval_locked.domain: Stop criteria, conformance definitions and trust/autonomy guard thresholds
independent_approval_locked.reason: D-353 and D-360: decided by the Torre with independent approval; an autonomous session never edits its own passing criteria.

independent_approval_locked.domain: Security exemptions (config/standard/tailoring/TAIL-*.json) and residual risk acceptance
independent_approval_locked.reason: D-353 and D-360: decided by the Torre with independent approval; never self-authorized by the author session.

independent_approval_locked.domain: GitHub permissions, workflows (.github/workflows/**) and branch rulesets (.github/rulesets/**)
independent_approval_locked.reason: D-353, D-360 and D-087: decided by the Torre with independent approval; sessions never self-install workflows or weaken check bindings.
D-353, D-360 and D-054: decided by the Torre with independent approval (changes involving money remain in LOCK-money).
